continuation_rules.target_radius: minimize complete updated W among all six types; independent new 64-person cohort
continuation_rules.logdet: maximize original logdet gain among all six types; independent new 64-person cohort
continuation_rules.frozen_random: cycle saved six-type random permutation, continuing at its fifth entry after the old four
continuation_rules.direct_target: repeat target in independent 64-person cohorts, stopping at the original attainment if already sufficient

coverage_scope: pointwise at deterministic design checkpoints and the design-only first attainment; no whole-long-path simultaneous coverage claim
sampling_scope: Continue the same original worlds; first visit to each type retains the original paired potential observation, repeated visits use fresh independent individual noise. No Gaussian replacement for Student-t or Rademacher.
cost_scope: Cumulative new participants excluding shared historical 64; also report max(new_n-256,0). Already attained methods keep their original first stop.
smoke_scope: Original replicate indices 0..2; a predetermined subset of full, not independent additional worlds.
supplementary_scope: Compute planned cost for width no larger than direct-target at 256; do not collect beyond the primary .60 stop for this secondary diagnostic.
